rationale: Identity CenterとSCIMは外部IdPの利用者・グループ情報を複数アカウントの認可基盤へ同期する最適な統合としてBが適切。元promptは即時に全ての既存セッションを失効させる一設定の手順を問うていない。公式SCIM資料は同期/無効化/削除時の動作がIdP実装に依存すると説明する。無効化は新しいポータル認証セッションを防ぐが、既存ポータルセッションからの追加role引受けは割当解除まで可能であり、発行済みIAMroleセッションも即時失効とは限らない。公式revoke guideは割当削除、portal session停止、必要なDeny対応等を別途示す。B解説とlearning.reasonに同期と完全な退職処理の境界を明記し、prompt・全choice text・正答B・既存の基盤選定意図・revision1を維持した。

issues: AWS公式資料で、SCIM同期時のユーザー無効化・割り当て解除の挙動と既存セッションへの影響を確認する。必要なら設問を権限プロビジョニングの同期に限定するか、セッション無効化の要件を追加する。

sourceEdits.after: SCIMでIdPの利用者・グループ情報を同期できる。無効化・削除時の動作はIdPに依存し、発行済みAWSロールセッションの即時失効は保証しない。

sourceAssessment.rationale: IAM Identity Center plus SCIM remains the best integration for reflecting external-IdP user and group changes across multiple accounts. AWS states that SCIM synchronization and update intervals are controlled by the IdP and that deprovisioning behavior may vary by IdP implementation. AWS also distinguishes removing assignments and ending sessions: a disabled user cannot create new sessions, but existing IAM role sessions can continue until their configured expiry. The proposed explanation and learning reason disclose those boundaries without adding an immediate-session-revocation requirement to the prompt. They preserve the prompt, all choice texts, correct B, and the existing integration-selection intent; the clarification therefore keeps revision 1.

sources.evidence: IAM Identity Center supports SCIM synchronization of IdP user and group information; synchronization timing and deprovisioning behavior are controlled by the IdP.
Full active-access revocation separately removes permission-set assignments, disables the identity-source user, ends portal sessions, and uses a deny policy while active IAM role sessions expire.
Existing IAM role sessions continue independently until the configured duration expires; user disablement or assignment removal does not guarantee immediate role-session loss.

revisionJudgment.reason: README.md increases revision only when the answer or question intent changes. These explanatory fields retain the best-integration question, correct B, all choices, and its synchronization intent while stating documented offboarding limits.

edits.before: User changes in the IdP can be synchronized.
edits.after: SCIM can synchronize user and group information from the IdP. Deactivation and deletion behavior depends on the IdP, and it does not guarantee immediate expiration of already issued AWS role sessions.
Use Identity Center and SCIM as the foundation for reflecting IdP changes, and also verify assignment removal and handling of existing sessions during offboarding.

edits.before: 可以同步 IdP 中的用户变更。
edits.after: SCIM 可以同步 IdP 中的用户和组信息。停用和删除时的行为取决于 IdP，且不保证已发放的 AWS 角色会话会立即失效。

edits.before: 将人员变动同步反映到授权中。
edits.after: 使用 Identity Center 和 SCIM 作为反映 IdP 变更的基础；在离职处理时，还要确认解除分配以及现有会话的处理。

edits.before: 可以同步 IdP 中的使用者變更。
edits.after: SCIM 可同步 IdP 的使用者與群組資訊。停用或刪除時的行為取決於 IdP，且不保證已發行的 AWS 角色工作階段會立即失效。

edits.before: 將人員異動同步反映到授權中。
edits.after: 使用 Identity Center 與 SCIM 作為反映 IdP 變更的基礎；在離職處理時，也要確認解除指派與既有工作階段的處理。

edits.before: IdP의 사용자 변경 사항을 동기화할 수 있습니다.
edits.after: SCIM을 통해 IdP의 사용자 및 그룹 정보를 동기화할 수 있다. 비활성화 및 삭제 시의 동작은 IdP에 따라 달라지며, 이미 발급된 AWS 역할 세션이 즉시 만료된다고 보장하지 않는다.
IdP 변경 사항을 반영하는 기반으로 Identity Center와 SCIM을 사용하고, 퇴직 처리에서는 할당 해제와 기존 세션 처리도 확인한다.

edits.before: As alterações de usuários no IdP podem ser sincronizadas.
edits.after: O SCIM pode sincronizar informações de usuários e grupos do IdP. O comportamento na desativação e exclusão depende do IdP e não garante a expiração imediata de sessões de função da AWS já emitidas.

edits.before: Refletir alterações de pessoal na autorização.
edits.after: Use o Identity Center e o SCIM como base para refletir as alterações do IdP e, no desligamento, confirme também a remoção de atribuições e o tratamento das sessões existentes.

edits.before: Les modifications d’utilisateurs dans l’IdP peuvent être synchronisées.
edits.after: SCIM peut synchroniser les informations sur les utilisateurs et les groupes depuis l’IdP. Le comportement lors de la désactivation ou de la suppression dépend de l’IdP et ne garantit pas l’expiration immédiate des sessions de rôle AWS déjà émises.

edits.before: Répercuter les changements de personnel dans les autorisations.
edits.after: Utilisez Identity Center et SCIM comme base pour répercuter les changements de l’IdP et, lors d’un départ, vérifiez aussi la suppression des attributions et le traitement des sessions existantes.

edits.before: Benutzeränderungen im IdP lassen sich synchronisieren.
edits.after: SCIM kann Benutzer- und Gruppeninformationen aus dem IdP synchronisieren. Das Verhalten bei Deaktivierung und Löschung hängt vom IdP ab und garantiert nicht, dass bereits ausgestellte AWS-Rollensitzungen sofort ablaufen.
Verwenden Sie Identity Center und SCIM als Grundlage, um IdP-Änderungen abzubilden, und prüfen Sie bei einem Austritt auch die Aufhebung von Zuweisungen und den Umgang mit bestehenden Sitzungen.

edits.before: Se pueden sincronizar los cambios de usuario del IdP.
edits.after: SCIM puede sincronizar información de usuarios y grupos desde el IdP. El comportamiento al desactivar o eliminar depende del IdP y no garantiza la expiración inmediata de las sesiones de rol de AWS ya emitidas.

edits.before: Reflejar los cambios de personal en las autorizaciones.
edits.after: Use Identity Center y SCIM como base para reflejar los cambios del IdP y, durante la desvinculación, confirme también la eliminación de asignaciones y el tratamiento de las sesiones existentes.

edits.before: Le modifiche agli utenti nell’IdP possono essere sincronizzate.
edits.after: SCIM può sincronizzare le informazioni su utenti e gruppi dall’IdP. Il comportamento in caso di disattivazione o eliminazione dipende dall’IdP e non garantisce la scadenza immediata delle sessioni di ruolo AWS già emesse.

edits.before: Riportare le modifiche al personale nelle autorizzazioni.
edits.after: Usa Identity Center e SCIM come base per riflettere le modifiche dell’IdP e, durante la cessazione del rapporto, verifica anche la rimozione delle assegnazioni e la gestione delle sessioni esistenti.

revisionDecision: 誤答解説と学習ノートのみの明確化。公開済み設問の既存のIdentity Center/SCIM基盤選定条件/出題意図/正答/選択肢本文を変えずrevision1を保持。
mainSourceAssessmentClarification: The author assessment phrase new sessions refers to new access-portal authentication sessions. Existing portal sessions may still assume new roles until assignments are removed; the root rationale explicitly preserves this distinction. The public explanation does not claim that disabling sync alone stops all new AWS role access.
